verification.notes: This statement attributes a public report to Alex Jones. His October 8, 2025 broadcast transcript says Owens sent a dead man's switch to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson, and others. The same broadcast includes Owens's clip describing a package sent to trusted recipients and specifically naming Max Blumenthal and Andrew Tate.

verification.notes: DOJ's own review found that the 2007 federal non-prosecution agreement for Epstein was a flawed resolution and that U.S. Attorney Alexander Acosta exercised poor judgment, supporting the narrower observation that Epstein received unusually favorable treatment. The same review found no professional misconduct or improper-factor basis, and no reviewed evidence establishes Epstein as 'the government's own.' The Tate-brothers clause is a counterfactual that cannot be tested.

records.speaker: Ed Elson

appearances.snippet: And he did that in 2021 and that is he created this community that he called Hustlers University and he said that this was going to be if you want to escape the matrix, which is sort of tagline, then join Hustlers University and I'll teach you how to do it. And what happened when you when you join Hustlers University. ... is he gave you instructions and he said, watch my live stream. and use these clipping tools, ... I want you to get up on social media, create a social media account that is related to Andrew Tate and Hustlers University, and I want you to post as many clips as humanly possible from those accounts. ... And at the end of each clip, you're going to add an affiliate link to Hustlers University. You're going to get people to join. ... join the group when you'll pay a little subscription fee to join the group and I will pay you a commission. ... for getting people into the group. And eventually he was getting billions and billions of views on TikTok, not from his own account, but from many different accounts.
